title: Marquee
description: An amber LED sign, edge to edge on black, cycling sincere lines and Beatles song titles with the transitions real signs use: scroll, wipe, drop-in, dissolve, roll, open. Type anything and your words go up in lights.
intent: One dot-matrix sign made beautiful: every LED a soft glowing dome with the dark ones faintly visible, a hand-set 5x7 bitmap font with real descenders, and transitions stepped dot by dot the way sign controllers do it.
sources: herb reference board: 4090 how are you? (pixel type), fa23 Y2K montage
